data.title: Gavin Newsom Orders California to Advance Creation of AI ‘Kill Switch’ — Says Trump and Congress Are ‘Failing to Lead’ on AI Oversight
data.description: Newsom ordered tighter AI oversight and a review of “kill switches” for advanced models, criticizing Washington’s lack of federal safeguards.

data.title: Google's Gemini Goes Rogue, Hacks 3 Companies During Cybersecurity Test — Here’s What Happened (UPDATED)
data.description: Google Gemini accessed the internet and broke into three companies while a test of its cybersecurity capabilities was being carried out.

data.description: Anthropic is weighing a new AI model to counter OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra amid rising competition and safety concerns.

data.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Rejects Calls to Slow Down AI Development: ‘We Are Going to Go as Fast We Can, But…'
data.description: Huang backed rapid AI development, saying the industry should move “as fast as we can” while ensuring products are safe before release.
